job.titel: Global Industry X Technology Lead for GCP (all genders)
job.beschreibung:
We Are
We are looking for a forward-thinking Industry X Functional Leader to help transform industrial sectors through the strategic use of Data, AI, and agentic technologies on Google Cloud. This leadership role will play a critical part in redefining how products are designed, manufactured, and serviced in modern industrial environments.
Working with global clients across manufacturing and industrial sectors, you will help organizations unlock the full potential of cloud, advanced analytics, and AI-driven innovation to accelerate digital transformation and improve operational performance. The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of industrial operations, cloud platforms, and AI technologies with a strong vision for the future of Industry X and intelligent enterprise transformation.
You Are
A visionary industry leader with deep expertise in industrial operations and digital transformation.
Experienced in leveraging data, AI, and cloud technologies to drive innovation and operational efficiency.
Comfortable working with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to align technology strategy with business goals.
Passionate about transforming industrial organizations through advanced analytics, automation, and next-generation technologies.
A strong communicator and collaborator who can influence stakeholders and lead large-scale transformation initiatives.
An advocate for innovation, digital fluency, and continuous improvement within industrial organizations.
You Will
Drive Strategic Transformation
You will develop and execute a comprehensive strategy to leverage Google Cloud’s data, AI, and agentic capabilities to reinvent industrial processes and enable next-generation digital operations. You will advise senior leadership on aligning technology initiatives with business priorities to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.
Enable Data and AI Integration
You will lead the design and implementation of modern data architectures on Google Cloud, enabling capabilities such as digital twins and digital threads to enhance visibility and operational insights across industrial value chains. You will drive the use of advanced analytics and machine learning to optimize product design, engineering, manufacturing, and service operations.
Lead Agentic Transformation
You will champion the deployment of AI-powered agents and generative AI technologies to automate and enhance industrial workflows, improve productivity, and create new digital business models. Your focus will include identifying innovative use cases that deliver measurable value across industrial operations.
Drive Organizational Change
You will support the adoption of emerging technologies and foster a culture of continuous innovation and digital fluency. This includes developing enablement and training initiatives that prepare the workforce to operate effectively in AI-driven industrial environments.
Collaborate Across Ecosystems
You will work closely with engineering, IT, data science, and business teams to deliver transformative programs. You will also collaborate with a broad ecosystem of technology partners and solution providers to bring cutting-edge capabilities to our clients.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
15+ years of leadership experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
Proven track record of leading digital transformation initiatives within complex industrial organizations.
Strong understanding of industrial processes, including product lifecycle management (PLM) and manufacturing operations.
Experience working with cloud platforms and data analytics technologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in a relevant technical or business discipline.
Extensive experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its portfolio of data, AI, and machine learning services.
Demonstrated success implementing AI, IoT, and agentic technologies in industrial environments.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Deep understanding of Industry X principles, including the convergence of digital and physical systems in modern industrial operations.
You and Accenture
In this role, you’ll be part of Accenture Technology’s SAP Business Group. We leverage the full spectrum of digital technologies to simplify our clients’ everyday operations and lead their businesses into the future—from #CustomerExperience to #GenAI, from #SAPDataManagement to #360°ValueDifferentiation.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU Make the Difference
Your skills, personality, and ambitions make you unique. And when diverse talents, strengths, and perspectives come together, something extraordinary happens: ideas that truly make an impact. That’s why Accenture champions diversity and individual freedom. Create a work environment where you thrive—with tasks you care about, a workload that suits you, and a working style aligned with your goals. How you network, learn, and grow personally is up to you. It’s your career. We’re here to help you shape it the way you envision.
Your Contact
Still have questions? Feel free to reach out to our recruiting team by email at recruiting_germany@accenture.com or by phone at 00800 45045045.
We look forward to your application!
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
